title: 1Password Hits $500M ARR and Launches AI Agent Security Platform
summary:
The password manager's yearly subscription income climbed by $100 million since November 2025, reaching $500 million in annual recurring revenue (ARR). 1Password attributes this expansion to the adoption of corporate AI coding assistants and agents among its enterprise clients. To support this demand, the company released 1Password for Agents, a platform that allows artificial intelligence tools to access site credentials without seeing or possessing the actual passwords.

The new system utilizes a request-and-approve model where 1Password auto-fills sign-in forms only after the user confirms the credential request from their vault. The platform is free and optional for personal and family accounts, and it requires an explicit opt-in for any agent to access a vault. Integration partners include OpenAI, Anthropic's Claude, Perplexity, and SpaceX's Grok.

selectedTweets.text:
Today we announce 1Password for Agents platform, building with companies @Muse, SpaceX Super Intelligence Grok @Bot, @AnthropicAI’s @Claudeai, @OpenAI, @TownAI, @Browserbase, @Browser_use, @heydana_ai, Instinct, @usekernel, @Perplexity_ai, @tryramp, @Tomo, and @wajo_ai,  with more integrations on the way. 🎉

We've heard from so many of our customers who want to use these new personal AI agents to help them get more done, but want more control over what the agent can access with the same trust and ease of use they get when using 1Password directly. 

1Password for Agents gives your agents access without giving up your passwords. When an agent reaches a sign-in form, it requests a credential from your vault. If you approve the request, 1Password directly auto-fills the credential in the destination site so the agent can’t see or take possession of the credentials. 

The agent gets the task done, but it doesn’t get your passwords..

You stay in control. 1Password for Agents free and optional for personal and family accounts. Unless you opt-in to an agent connector, agents cannot touch your vault.
